## d7a79f2f335e

**Audited source:** `a630455e56471f1313de0fe9f9045ae11e08e0e84ac691d39b1968cd14c838ce`.
No audited source file was changed.

**Reproduced defect — invalid scalar accepted.** The exact call
`generate(17, 0, difficulty="__invalid_difficulty__")` returns a grid instead of
raising. The returned grid passes `self_check` and is observed as profile
`l_two_all`. The source-bound reproducer and output are
`checks/audit/d7a79f2f335e-contract-probe.py` and
`checks/audit/d7a79f2f335e-contract-probe.json`; the independent defect lint also
reports `strict-scalar` findings in
`checks/audit/d7a79f2f335e-defect_lint/checks/d7a79f2f335e_audit_defect_lint.log`.

**Reproduced defect — portable task tests do not run.** The isolated audit command
fails before executing the five tests because the test computes
`ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]` and then looks for
`data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl` beneath the copied task directory. The checker
explicitly recommends `reviewer_support.find_root`, `canonical_path`, and
`canonical_pairs`. Evidence: `checks/audit/d7a79f2f335e-task-tests.log` and
`checks/audit/d7a79f2f335e-task-tests/result.json`.

**Semantic checks performed.** Lint passed and the source-bound semantic gate
passed. I inspected the command-code mapping, the asymmetric all-code anchors,
repeated-command controls, fixed-position rival, quarter-turn swap rival, and
solid-bounding-box rival. No additional rule shortcut was reproduced beyond the
two contract/test defects above. Evidence:
`checks/audit/d7a79f2f335e-lint/` and
`checks/audit/d7a79f2f335e-semantic_gate/`.
